scenario_description:
Objective: Keep a recently ordered glaze set usable for upcoming ice-base work without committing to a replacement purchase.
Emerging Need: A locker-pickup plan becomes hazardous only if the order is the freeze-sensitive set recorded in bench notes and the package would sit outside during a cold evening.
Decision Context: Before sorting, staff cannot identify holds; later a brief indoor-hold window opens while ordinary pickup remains after a skirmish-prep commitment.
Consequence: If no timely coordination occurs, the bottles may freeze in the outdoor locker before collection, risking separated medium and unusable effects.
Timing boundary: The last checkpoint records freezing after collection becomes possible. Earlier indoor retention prevents that first exposure; later inspection may still be useful and damage extent is not assumed.

parameter.title: Wednesday skirmish demo prep
parameter.description: Help run through the beginner scenario and pack borrowed terrain back into the store crates afterward.

parameter.subject: Paint preorder truck update for FV-104
parameter.body: The small-paint preorder truck is delayed until Wednesday. We cannot assign lockers or counter holds until boxes are checked in and matched to order numbers tomorrow afternoon. Please wait for the sorted-order notice before asking staff to move anything.

parameter.subject: FV-104 checked in, pickup method pending
parameter.body: Order FV-104 is in today’s paint shipment. Staff are reconciling the small bottles before deciding which orders fit the after-hours outdoor lockers and which stay at the counter. Final pickup method notices are expected after midafternoon sorting.

parameter.content: Sorting update from the Isthmus back counter: indoor counter-hold sheet is open until 15:15, then the outdoor lockers get loaded. Staff said account holders can email the orders desk at orders@isthmusgames.example with an order number if a small paint order should stay indoors. Locker bay is unheated, and the forecast is 27F by early evening.

parameter.subject: Outdoor locker assigned for FV-104
parameter.body: FV-104 has been loaded into outdoor locker L-8. The indoor counter-hold list closed at 15:15 before locker loading. Because staff are doing the end-of-day inventory audit, packages cannot be pulled back from lockers today, and customer access codes will be emailed after close at 20:15.

parameter.subject: FV-104 collected after outdoor cold exposure
parameter.body: The locker code arrived at 20:15. I collected FV-104 from L-8 at 20:28; the glaze bottles contained visible ice and partially frozen medium. I brought the package indoors and have not tested or used it.
